note: Changelog entry for 0.31.0 - the Notification hook now pings only when a work item newly arrives at a user gate. Synthesized from the member's report bundle; before/ carries the plan-time as-is baseline for viewer compare mode.

diagrams.title: notify-only-at-user-gates: Notification payload -> gogo_notify_decide() -> level switch -> type classifier -> state.md gate scan -> D4 edge-latch vs .gogo/resources/notify/gates -> send or stay silent, with the --selftest entry and a GOGO_NOTIFY_DEBUG trace on every path
